text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer, let's go.
To our class Christmas party.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: The host cannot keep everyone waiting, after all.

“—Today is Christmas.
Narita Top Road was hosting a Christmas party for all of her classmates.”

Just as I was about to head outside
toward the cafeteria venue—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Snow...?

Powder snow had begun
to flutter down lightly from the sky.

It felt like a romantic gift
from God, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Mmh...
choice_data_list: Huh... Are you in a bad mood or something?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Of course that's the case. Because...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It'll be troublesome if it turns yielding, won't it? The track condition for the Arima Kinen, that is.

...Now that I think about it, that was true.
Narita Top Road isn't particularly fond of poor track conditions.

Only a few days until the Arima Kinen.
Let's pray this weather doesn't keep up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Is everyone here?
Merry Christmas to you all.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAAHHH!!
I've been waiting for you, Class Rep~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you sooo much
for throwing a Christmas party for usssss!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, shut it. If you yell that loud,
you're gonna bother Top Road too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, gonna chomp on chicken.
And tackle the whole cake all by myself too.

Those gathered were classmates such as
Winning Ticket, Narita Taishin,
and Shinko Windy.

With an atmosphere quite different from the one with our peers,
the Christmas party carried on—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Well then, it's about time to wrap things up, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. Since we're borrowing the Tracen Academy
facilities for this, staying late just isn't an option.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fineee, don't worry about it, Class Rep~.
You even negotiated for us, didn't youuu?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No other Umamusume would ever go this far for me!
Waaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha... You're exaggerating...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Are you drunk off juice, Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's always like this even when I just drink water.
Don't worry about it."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Anyway, as long as you're happy with it, that's what matters.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Let's all get along and do our best again next year.

Just as Narita Top Road is about to
pleasantly wrap up the gathering...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a sec!
The prank Windy-chan and the others set up
hasn't even gone off yet!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh, a prank...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It's not a prank. It's a surprise.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, that's right!
I have to hand it over at the end of the party.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa, this is from all of us.
Here you go, Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
For me? Thank you so much.
I wonder what it could be...?
Opening the package, what was inside was...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"These are... teru teru bozu!
And so many of them! Are they all handmade?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Praying that we get
good weather for the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: We all poured our wishes into making them! My wish was so big that its head ended up huge, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"You know, just because.
You're always doing so much for me."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Calling it a present, huh...
Isn't this just a return gift?
We're the ones receiving something here.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Even Windy-chan can show appreciation
sometimes! You always apologize with me
when the teacher's chewing me out."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: If it rains, I'll bite right back at the sky!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Thank you...
I'm honored that you care for me this much.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best on race day!
To live up to everyone's expectations!

Narita Top Road looked happy.
To her, her classmates were the ones
who looked like Santa Claus bringing presents, but...

Narita Top Road herself might just be the Santa Claus
who regularly brings happiness to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, that turned out to be
a truly wonderful gathering.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
To think that everyone
would treat me so kindly.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's all thanks to your good deeds.
Yeah, that's all thanks to your daily conduct.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: My everyday behavior? Mine?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Not at all...
If anything, I am the one who is truly grateful.

At this Christmas party...
I felt like I caught a glimpse of the path Narita Top Road has walked.
It wasn't a path of stoic, solitary effort—

Always extending a hand to someone,
and those touched by that kindness...

A road lined with supporters cheering on
Narita Top Road, who always gives it her all.

A road lined with supporters cheering on
Narita Top Road, who always gives it her all.

"And late into the night...
as the two of them walked through the city."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-san.
An idea just came to me, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Do you think we should
exchange presents with each other?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Normally, people do it, right?
Exchanging Christmas presents, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yet for some reason... I just don't feel like doing it with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I don't really want extravagant gifts,
and I already know giving them won't bring any joy either.
Their bond was no longer tied to material things. It felt as though they didn't need them anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Still! Even if we aren't exchanging gifts,
there's someone I want to give a gift to together with you."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
We'll do that.
Just not today, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Arima Kinen.
To our teacher—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to gift you the most wonderful victory.
Along with my heartfelt gratitude.

It was an agreement. I want to see Sensei smile.
A genuine smile from the bottom of their heart, by any means, no matter what.

That alone was the unwavering feeling
shared between Narita Top Road and myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, come to think of it... maybe it's only natural not to want a present.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"We've already received
more than enough, after all."
choice_data_list: What do you mean by enough?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That day when we decided
to aim for the top together...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Me to you, Trainer. You to me. Both of us... from Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I don't think there could be any better gift.

A single encounter, more precious than
tens or hundreds of gifts.

The time spent devoting myself alongside
Narita Top Road was the greatest gift
that completely changed my life.
